mapper.insert: INSERT INTO #{schema}.ecos_scenario_decision_record (id, scenario_id, mind_id, forecast_run_id, run_mode, verdict, owner_user_id, due_date, approver_user_id, expected_impact, control_metric, action_plan_json, source_refs_json, compliance_verdict, compliance_detail_json, create_by, create_time, update_by, update_time, is_deleted, version_no, domain) VALUES (#{row.id}, #{row.scenarioId}, #{row.mindId}, #{row.forecastRunId}, #{row.runMode}, #{row.verdict}, #{row.ownerUserId}, #{row.dueDate}, #{row.approverUserId}, #{row.expectedImpact}, #{row.controlMetric}, #{row.actionPlanJson}, #{row.sourceRefsJson}, #{row.complianceVerdict}, #{row.complianceDetailJson}, #{row.createBy}, NOW(), #{row.updateBy}, NOW(), 0, 0, #{row.domain})
mapper.select: SELECT id, scenario_id, forecast_run_id, run_mode, verdict, owner_user_id, due_date, approver_user_id, expected_impact, control_metric, create_time FROM #{schema}.ecos_scenario_decision_record WHERE scenario_id = #{scenarioId} AND is_deleted = 0 ORDER BY create_time DESC
